file: # NOT PLACED, and why. Ten photographs were supplied beyond the eight above.

#   two grand-hall receptions   would read as College occasions the College did
#                               not hold. It teaches at a distance and convenes
#                               nowhere; the photograph would say otherwise.
#   a counter with bottles      whatever they hold, on the site of a college of
#                               the Qur'ānic sciences the reading is a hazard
#                               that no caption can undo.
#   three car interiors         nothing in them touches study.
#   two flat-lays of a watch,   these read as luxury goods rather than
#     a phone and a watch box   scholarship, and pull the site toward a
#                               lifestyle brand, which is the opposite of what
#                               prestige is doing here.
